zh.title: 澤倫斯基稱 Starshield 速限再現，影響攔截俄羅斯噴射動力無人機
zh.summary: 澤倫斯基稱 Starshield 速限妨礙烏克蘭部隊攔截俄羅斯噴射無人機
body: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基於2026年11月12日表示，Starshield（SpaceX Starlink衛星服務的軍規版本）在移動速度超過每小時161公里的設備上再次失去連線。他說，烏克蘭部隊數日來在整條前線及俄羅斯佔領區回報Starshield運作出現明顯中斷。
澤倫斯基稱，這項速度限制主要妨礙攔截俄羅斯噴射動力無人機。他還說，已有攻擊得手，因烏克蘭攔截器無法在維持連線時達到必要速度；他沒有指出具體攻擊事件。
澤倫斯基稱，烏克蘭軍方調查後認為相關限制屬系統性速度限制，而非隨機錯誤。報導未交代限制何時開始或由誰施加，並稱基輔正與美方釐清相關情況。

en.title: Zelenskyy says renewed Starshield speed cap hinders interception of Russian jet-powered drones
en.summary: Zelenskyy says Starshield speed restrictions hinder Ukraine's efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.
body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on November 12, 2026, that Starshield, the military-grade version of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite service, was again losing connectivity on equipment moving faster than 161 km/h in Ukraine. He said Ukrainian units had reported significant disruptions for several days across the entire front line and in Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.

Zelenskyy said the speed restriction was primarily disrupting efforts to intercept Russian jet-powered drones. He also said some attacks had already succeeded because Ukrainian interceptors could not reach the necessary speeds while maintaining connectivity, but he did not identify specific strikes.

Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian military had investigated and concluded the restrictions were systematic, not random errors. The report did not specify when they began or who imposed them, and said Kyiv was trying to establish the circumstances with the American side.
